purpose: Acquire and calibrate a heterogeneous ten-source set before any 50-100-study machine-screened run.

existing_verified_sources.role: Completed same-source engineering calibration and human-reviewed reference source

acquisition_targets.calibration_role: Randomised 2x2 factorial intervention; multi-arm participant flow and combined intervention
Evidence-synthesis layout; multiple studies, outcomes and follow-up timepoints
Measurement review; explicit missingness and no intervention-arm structure
Within-participant graph learning with delayed neuroimaging sessions
Behavioural retrieval-practice experiment with confidence and fMRI
Acute-stress experimental mechanism study with statistical learning and fMRI
Three controlled learning experiments and negative/null intervention evidence
Quasi-experimental classroom study with intact classes, AI conditions and independent no-AI follow-up
Three-wave longitudinal observational survey with self-report constructs

selection_basis.discovery_requirement: preferred direct-PDF candidate in a Stage 13 OA discovery manifest
selection_basis.access_requirement: lawful open-access or repository route; no institutional credentials
selection_basis.identity_requirement: downloaded PDF must match expected DOI or title before registration
exclusions: rt-2026-014 is already full-text verified and is not redownloaded
rt-2026-016 and rt-2026-017 had discovery errors and no direct-PDF candidate
blocked or closed sources remain outside this calibration acquisition batch
